## Active

### D-032 — A meta/dbTest YAML filename names the handler that merges it

> _2026-08-23 · core/blong-server · active_

The last `-`-separated segment of the YAML filename maps to the handler method:
`commander-accessAuthorizationMerge.yaml` is merged by `access.authorization.merge`. Any realm's
`meta/dbTest/*.yaml` is auto-bound as `<realm>.dbTest.asset` — `meta` is a well-known
auto-discovered layer and nested `db`/`dbTest` folders are scanned as handler groups — and the
shared `srv.db` adapter's `processSeedAssets` merges the YAML by dispatching
`ctx.handle(params, {method})`.

### D-459 — The collected models live in a shared module, not on the port config

> _2026-10-08 · core/blong-server · active_

The models `subject.ts` collects live in `core/blong-server/subjectModels.ts`, a module at the
package root, and not on the port config as before. The config a definition is handed is a
per-module slice: `subject.validation` is not attached to the `srv.subject` port, so its config
never carried the `context.subjectModels` slot the port filled, and it read zero models while the
port had collected thirteen (F-437). A module is one instance per process for every importer, so the
port writes are the validation reads and `subjectModelList` answers from the same place - the three
files can no longer disagree. The slot is gone from the port rather than kept beside the store,
because two places holding the same map is how the disagreement started.
